## C++ Gateway

```cpp
template <size_t MaximumMessageBytes = 1024, size_t ReassemblySlots = 2, size_t OutboundFrames = 32, size_t PendingRequests = 8, size_t Links = 4, size_t Routes = 16, size_t Discoveries = 4, size_t Candidates = 16, size_t Assignments = 8, size_t ForwardingFrames = 32, size_t ControlBytes = 128, size_t ControlSlots = 2>
class corelib::Gateway
```

Fixed-storage owner and type-safe facade for one PFP gateway.

MaximumMessageBytes Maximum endpoint message bytes. ReassemblySlots Endpoint reassembly slots. OutboundFrames Endpoint outbound frames. PendingRequests Endpoint pending requests. Links Registered link capacity. Routes Installed route capacity. Discoveries Active discovery capacity. Candidates Retained candidate capacity. Assignments Pending assignment capacity. ForwardingFrames Routed frame capacity. ControlBytes Maximum local control message bytes. ControlSlots Local control reassembly slots.
